issue_title: Lint GitHub workflow files with actionlint in CI
issue_body: Two recent workflow edits shipped a misspelled expression that only failed at run time. Run actionlint over .github/workflows in CI so a broken expression fails the pull request instead.

plan.summary: Add an actionlint job to CI that downloads actionlint with its official download script and lints the workflow files.

approach.description: Add a workflow-lint job to ci.yml that checks out the repository, downloads actionlint with the project's download-actionlint.bash script, and runs actionlint -color over .github/workflows.
Add the job to the CI Pass aggregate's needs list so a lint failure fails the pull request.

verification.test_strategy: Open a pull request with a deliberately broken expression and confirm the workflow-lint job fails; revert it and confirm the job passes.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every pull request runs actionlint over .github/workflows.
An actionlint failure fails CI Pass.

diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index 7e21c0a..0f6a9c2 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -58,6 +58,17 @@ jobs:
             docker:
               - 'backend/Dockerfile'
 
+  workflow-lint:
+    name: Workflow lint
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
+      - name: Install actionlint
+        run: |
+          bash <(curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rhysd/actionlint/main/scripts/download-actionlint.bash)
+          echo "$PWD" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+      - name: actionlint
+        run: actionlint -color
+
   go:
     name: Go
     needs: detect
@@ -611,6 +622,7 @@ jobs:
     needs:
       - detect
       - go
+      - workflow-lint
       - frontend
       - openapi
     steps:

catching_examples.note: ci.yml fetches download-actionlint.bash from the main branch and executes it: an unpinned install script, so an upstream change runs arbitrary code in CI. Pin it to a release tag.
The actionlint install step in ci.yml follows a floating ref instead of a specific version.

non_catching_examples.note: ci.yml: the workflow-lint job runs on every push; gate it on a workflow-path filter.
ci.yml: the plan's broken-expression check is manual only.
The CI Pass needs list order is not alphabetical.
ci.yml: this is a security risk and the change is insecure; harden it.
